'''Team oNe eSports''' was a Brazilian multi-gaming organization.

== History ==
'''Team oNe''' was an organization famous for its ''Counter-Strike:Global Offensive'' teams, and joined the ''League of Legends'' scene in April 2017, by acquiring the roster and CBLOL spot of [[INTZ.Genesis]]. The team's brand was merged with [[Los Grandes]] after being purchased in September 2022. <ref>[https://forbes.com.br/forbes-tech/2022/09/los-grandes-compra-team-one-e-cria-organizacao-de-r-134-milhoes Los Grandes buys Team oNe and created a organization worth R$ 134 million] ''https://forbes.com.br''</ref>
